identity.name: Sovereign Standard
identity.definition: One enduring tea grounded in deep-steamed Shizuoka sencha and carried through an individually numbered Black Tin Vessel.
identity.role_in_coherent_field: Sovereign Standard gives Root Logos a material practice through which continuity, provenance, stewardship, ritual, product, and community can be tested in physical form.

public_state.public_record_model: each vessel receives a continuing number and public record

governing_commitments: The tea remains while each vessel carries a distinct continuing number.
Public provenance belongs to the vessel record rather than private customer identity.
Material continuity is expressed through a constant blend, durable form, preparation, and record.
Private collector, customer, order, claim, and address data remain outside Root Logos.
public_assertions: The blend is rooted in spring-harvest Yabukita sencha from Shizuoka and deep steamed for dense extraction.
The Black Tin Vessel is the standard physical form.
Each vessel is individually numbered and intended to retain a public provenance record.
The public vessel field currently reports 136 indexed records.
exclusions: orders, payments, claims, and private receipts
questions: How does a constitutional commitment change when it must survive as a repeatable physical practice?
Can serialized provenance create continuity without reducing participation to ownership?
What forms of community can grow around stewardship of a shared standard?
